review_comments.body:
** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Preserve distinct custom header names.** If a message contains the custom header `Templateuuid`, the new filter removes it. `from_message` looks up `template_uuid` as `template-uuid`, so it does not copy this value to the structured field either. Before this change, the custom header was retained. The same issue affects `Templatevariables`. Match the actual template field names without removing their hyphens. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikel/mail/2.9.1/lib/mail/header.rb))

Merge Risk: Low · up to b0e9c

The change stops ActionMailer template fields from being sent as custom headers. A custom header whose name happens to be Templateuuid or Templatevariables, without hyphens, will now be silently dropped. This is a rare edge case, so the change is mergeable with owner awareness.
